summary: Xinyuan Real Estate Co., Ltd., a Beijing-based foreign private issuer listed on the NYSE, furnished a Form 6-K announcing routine board composition changes. Directors Yifan Li and Yong Cui resigned effective April 27, 2026 and May 12, 2026, respectively, and Jian Zhang was appointed as a director effective July 8, 2026, per a duly executed board resolution. No stake, price, premium, advisor, or recommendation was disclosed. The departures are staggered and board-initiated rather than an abrupt controlling-officer exit, so this is treated as ordinary governance housekeeping rather than a forced management change; it maps to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02 disclosure. No deal or risk-arb angle exists.
